name: mathbox-bu
description: Bellevue University PhD Data Science edition of Mathbox: auditable mathematical, statistical and machine-learning research with claim tracking, source verification and reproducible experiments

interface.longDescription: Mathbox adapted for a Bellevue University PhD in Data Science (Applied AI & ML): pursue research goals across distinct routes, audit proofs and statistical/ML derivations, verify sources with APA 7 records, and record reproducible experiments on public, simulated or authorized enterprise data.
interface.developerName: Rajkumar Kuppuswami (customization of Mathbox by Najib Idrissi-Kaïtouni)
defaultPrompt: Audit this estimator's consistency proof and isolate the first unproved step.
Check that this ML experiment's evaluation has no train/test leakage and record its scope.
Verify what the cited paper proves and draft an APA 7 source record.
